question: What is the best time to visit Kashmir?
answer: Kashmir is truly a year-round destination with distinctive seasonal charm. Spring (March to May) brings blooming tulips, mustard fields, and pleasant temperatures (15°C to 25°C). Summer (June to August) is ideal for lush green valleys, Shikara rides, and escaping city heat. Autumn (September to November) brings golden Chinar trees and saffron harvest. Winter (December to February) blankets Gulmarg, Pahalgam, and Srinagar in snow, making it paradise for snow lovers and ski enthusiasts.
